Rules info

⚠️ For fun only. Kiwi Catch is a game, not legal advice. Fishing rules change and there are local closures, rāhui and special restrictions. Always check the official NZ Fishing Rules app (MPI) or mpi.govt.nz before you go fishing.
Blue cod: Napier is in FMA 2 (Titahi Bay → Cape Runaway): limit 20, min 33 cm, land whole or gutted. Taranaki → Titahi Bay (FMA 8) limit is only 2. Hāpuku limit is combined Groper/Bass (accumulation limit 3 over multi-day trips).
Sources (checked 1 Nov 2026)
• MPI – Central area fishing rules: mpi.govt.nz/fishing-aquaculture/recreational-fishing/fishing-rules/central-fishing-rules/
• MPI – NZ Fishing Rules mobile app (free, iOS & Android)
• MPI – October 2026 sustainability round: new tarakihi daily limit of 10 from 1 Nov 2026
Fish lengths, weights, odds and fun facts in the game are approximate and for gameplay only.

How scoring works
✅ Keep a legal fish: points by species value, size & rarity (giants ×3)
🛡️ Release an undersize fish: Guardian bonus +30
🔁 Release a legal fish: +10 (smart release at a limit +25)
🚫 Keep undersize: −100 · Keep over a daily limit: −120
